class_name.description: Solution for kind function, otherwise the class being designed

method.description: Entry point method for kind function; empty string for design

inplace_param.description: Index of the argument the method mutates and the judge compares; -1 when the return value is the answer

statement_md.description: Original problem statement in markdown, with examples and constraints

starter_code.description: Compilable Java skeleton for the candidate

support_code.description: Extra non-public top-level Java classes the solutions need; usually empty

brute_solution.description: Simple, obviously correct Java solution for tiny inputs, full source

input.description: Argument list (function) or operation list (design), as JSON
Argument list (function) or operation list (design), as JSON

generator_py.description: Python source defining gen(rng, size, level=1)

checker_py.description: Python source defining check(case_input, actual), or an empty string

perf_size.description: size passed to gen for the stress case

levels.description: Only for multi-level builds; otherwise empty
